public enum PredatorType extends Enum<PredatorType>

  • Enum Constant Details

    • SPIDER

      public static final PredatorType SPIDER
      Ambush predator that builds webs to trap ants. Low mobility, high trap effectiveness.

    • ANTLION

      public static final PredatorType ANTLION
      Pit trap predator that digs cone-shaped traps in sand. Stationary, extremely effective in sandy terrain.

    • BEETLE

      public static final PredatorType BEETLE
      Fast ground hunter that chases prey. High mobility, moderate damage.

    • BIRD

      public static final PredatorType BIRD
      Aerial predator that swoops down on surface ants. Very fast, attacks from above.

    • LIZARD

      public static final PredatorType LIZARD
      Large predator that can consume multiple ants. Slow but devastating when it attacks.

    • WASP

      public static final PredatorType WASP
      Aerial insect.
